common_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / identity-preserve.
Asset type: ONE square Steam Workshop cover candidate for SuQing's Search Enhancement, an inventory-search game mod. This is a new composition derived from the supplied references.
Input roles: Image 1 is the PRIMARY canonical character identity and anatomy authority. Images 2, 3, 4 are the actual approved SERIES COVERS, references ONLY for anime/pixel-hybrid rendering, lighting, ornate lower title-plaque branding and finish. Do not copy their buyback, refrigerator or irrigation scenes or their other mod names.
Style: deliberately crisp highly detailed anime/pixel-art HYBRID matching images 2-4, fine anime face with clean stepped pixel edges and textured dithered wood, detailed fabric and pixel highlights. Strong lavender/purple and warm amber lighting. Not soft washed-out watercolor, not glossy 3D, not photorealism, not flat vector, not crude low-resolution 8-bit.
Character invariants: SAME adult dragon woman as Image 1; same slender face, lilac eyes and body proportions, long loose flowing silver-WHITE hair with pale lavender shadows, paired pale ivory segmented curved dragon horns, pointed ears, WHITE coiled-flower rosette side ornament with fine hanging tassels, pale lavender membrane dragon WINGS with white frames and a long WHITE SCALED dragon TAIL. Clearly show both horns, at least both wing shapes and visible tail. Recognizable original flowing white and pale lavender dress, embroidered floral knots and draping sleeves. No new hair bun, no crown, no changed hair or eye color, no childlike chibi proportions. Blue spirit is optional and should be omitted in these candidates.
Series layout: upper roughly 73% is character, thematic scene and visible practical search prop. Lower roughly 27% is an ornate deep PURPLE woven/embroidered title plaque exactly in the branding language of images 2-4: restrained gold/beaded border, purple flowers, stylized dragon motifs, small corner ornaments and tassels. Large character identity remains legible in a 512px thumbnail. Do not use a top floating title.
Text verbatim: First line on lower plaque: "蘇清的" in ivory/pale gold. Second line significantly larger: "搜索增强" in light lavender with legible sharp strokes and subtle shadow. Third line small elegant serif English: "SuQing's Search Enhancement". All text INSIDE safe margins, exact characters, no additional words. Do not write the other reference mod titles. Do not write any version numbers, Build/B42 marks, SINGLE PLAYER, logos, signatures or watermark.
Function expression: unmistakable large magnifying glass visually linked to a backpack, storage chest, book or selected useful supply. It represents finding existing carried and nearby belongings. No literal game screen/UI, no floating search bars, no unreadable labels, no combat.
Quality constraints: one single complete square cover, opaque background; natural anatomy and hand-object interaction; no extra person, duplicate character, extra limb or fingers. Keep white hair/dress white under colored lights. Save one polished candidate, not a collage or grid.

Scene A — amber-lit supply storeroom: medium three-quarter composition, the character stands slightly to the right beside a broad open wooden supply chest.
